works.title: FrEIA
works.subtitle: Fragment End Integrated Analysis
works.problem: Shallow WGS is afordable but lacks the depth needed for conventional mutation-based ctDNA detection.
works.method: Snakemake pipeline extracting cfDNA fragment-end sequence proportions and diversity, integrating copy-number aberration, fragment size, and end-sequence features into a FrEIA score with machine-learning classification for cancer detection.
works.impact: Open-source toolkit used in multi-modal cfDNA genomic and fragmentomic analyses for cancer survival and recurrence.

works.title: ITSFASTR
works.subtitle: Ultra-fast cfDNA analysis · ONT · Illumina
works.problem: Long (>500 bp) cell-free DNA fragments from nanopore sequencing challenge assumptions about tumor-derived fragment length in liquid biopsy.
works.method: End-to-end bioinformatics pipeline for real-time analysis of the cancer genome and fragmentome from plasma and urine cfDNA using Oxford Nanopore and Illumina sequencing data.
works.impact: Pipeline and study published in EMBO Molecular Medicine, demonstrating the value of long-reads for liquid biopsy.

works.title: Ouro-tools
works.subtitle: Circular RNA from long-read liquid biopsies
works.problem: Full-length circular RNA in liquid biopsies is hard to recover and quantify with short-read-centric workflows, limiting its use as a cancer biomarker.
works.method: Preprocessing and analysis pipeline for circular RNA from Oxford Nanopore sequencing of liquid biopsy material, developed under ZonMw funding for cervical cancer detection.
works.impact: ZonMw grant (2023): Full-length Circular RNA Detection in Liquid Biopsies for Cervical Cancer Detection. Companion tooling for ONT circRNA workflows.

featured.title: Multi-modal cell-free DNA genomic and fragmentomic patterns enhance cancer survival and recurrence analysis
featured.problem: Tumor-derived cfDNA is cleaved differently from healthy DNA, but shallow WGS needs robust end-sequence metrics to turn that biology into a detection signal.
featured.method: Snakemake pipeline extracting fragment-end sequence proportions and diversity, integrating copy-number aberration, fragment size, and end-sequence features into a FrEIA score with machine-learning classification for cancer detection.
featured.impact: Open-source toolkit used in multi-modal cfDNA genomic and fragmentomic analyses for cancer survival and recurrence (PMID 38128532).

featured.title: Real-time analysis of the cancer genome and fragmentome from plasma and urine cell-free DNA using nanopore sequencing
featured.problem: Long (>500 bp) cell-free DNA fragments from nanopore sequencing challenge assumptions about tumor-derived fragment length in liquid biopsy.
featured.method: End-to-end bioinformatics pipeline for real-time analysis of the cancer genome and fragmentome from plasma and urine cfDNA using Oxford Nanopore and Illumina sequencing data.
featured.impact: Pipeline and study published in EMBO Molecular Medicine (PMID 37942753), demonstrating long-read fragmentomics for liquid biopsy.

featured.title: Third-generation Sequencing Reveals Extensive Polycistronism and Transcriptional Overlapping in a Baculovirus
featured.problem: Short-read assays under-resolve overlapping and polycistronic transcription in compact viral genomes, obscuring true transcript architecture.
featured.method: PacBio long-read sequencing of Autographa californica multiple nucleopolyhedrovirus RNA to map full-length isoforms, polycistronic RNAs, and transcriptional overlaps.
featured.impact: First-author Scientific Reports study establishing long-read isoform mapping for a prototype baculovirus transcriptome.
